column1: # The save editor's reference names (docs/save-editor.md section 4). The build copies this file
# beside the launcher, and the editor reads that copy: edit this one.
# UTF-8, tab-separated. Columns: kind id name x z flags status source.
#   kind    master | gene | formation | fish | chapter | area | entrance
#   id      the number the save holds (decimal or 0x hex); for an entrance, the area
#   name    what the editor shows beside the number
#   x z flags   an entrance's position in cells and its entry flags byte; empty for the other kinds
#   status source   this repository's own record of where the name comes from; the editor does not read them
# Masters, genes, formations and fish are the US release's words, read by index from an install's
# English text (2026-11-10). A chapter's label and most area names are ours, for recognition: an
# area's `cited` name is one source's word for the place, and is not always the game's own.
# Areas with no row show as a number. The entrances of an area are not here: the editor reads them
# from the install's BOF3.exe (Area_Descriptors' link lists). An `entrance` row adds one by hand.
